Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for a vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Each subject must fit within central 80% of its own quadrant with generous margins; NOTHING crosses the horizontal or vertical midlines. Row-major fixed order. Fully contain hands, feet and objects. Simple silhouettes legible as 320px icons; medium restrained detail, no elaborate environment. Adult-friendly editorial art, realistic recognizable objects, natural human proportions. No captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only a symbol/number explicitly requested in a cell is allowed. Meanings are guidance, DO NOT write them. Avoid illustrating another sense of the word. Fill exactly the specified cells; any unused cell stays blank white. The FOUR CELLS are:

TOP RIGHT — tell (v.告诉): A clear compact educational illustration of 'tell', specifically its curriculum meaning 'v.告诉'; show a concrete object or minimal human situation that conveys precisely that meaning.
BOTTOM LEFT — truth (n.实情): a person admitting a broken cup with an honest open-hand gesture, no mask or deception glamor
BOTTOM RIGHT — Greece (n.希腊): a compact accurate recognizable Parthenon temple on a hill, geographic mnemonic, no modern skyline
